test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence which has no spelling error.

options.text: A magnifisent Humayun tomb was built by Hamida Bano in Delhi.
There are many magnificent churches in Goa.
The sight of waterfall was magnifecent in the brochure.
The bride looked bright, simple and magneficent.

solution:
The correct answer is **"There are many magnificent churches in Goa."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The common word is **"magnificent"** in all the given sentences.
 
• Magnificent denotes a size that is **stunning and proportionate** to scale without compromising **decency or aesthetic taste**.
 
• According to english grammar, the correct word is **"magnificent" **which is correct only in the second option.
 
• The remaining sentences' spellings of **"magnificent"** are wrong.

Therefore, **option two** is correct.
